summary: Route configured daemon GitHub HTTP through sekrets authorized requests without holding the token

replay.detail: No persisted observer cursors or delivery receipts change; existing conditional-response caches are preserved.

schema.detail: No database or graph schema changes. Uses the independently owned gateway authorized-request protocol and existing Config.github.sekrets_profile.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digest or coordinated member upgrade.

compatibility.detail: github.sekrets_profile now selects gateway authorized-request for every daemon GitHub HTTP caller and direct GitHub gate CLI, passing full Config for node identity. The profile branch contains no token, never resolves file/env/gh credentials and never falls back. Request method/body, status and all headers remain available; no redirect follow or HTTP replay. Unconfigured GH_TOKEN > GITHUB_TOKEN > gh auth token cache and explicit token_file behavior remain unchanged. The caller independently validates https/api.github.com/no-userinfo/default-port and refuses its own Authorization, streamed request bodies or buffered requests above16MiB. It checks the64MiB RPC response-body cap before constructing the response.

downtime.detail: No replay/migration. Profile configuration no longer rejects startup as unsupported; unavailable gateway or denied identity/grant/URL fail the request without fallback. Restart-to-health and production performance are not measured.

manual.detail: Deploy the authorized-request gateway/client dependency and caller source before configuring github.sekrets_profile. Register the existing node key and grant OWNER/NAME to host/NODE with github-api; the daemon and CLI pass their loaded Config. Configure ST_SEKRETS_SOCKET or the default gateway socket. Only https://api.github.com is allowed, so alternate API base overrides are refused in profile mode. token_file and profile remain mutually exclusive. See docs/github-integration.md and docs/st3/sekrets.md.

recovery.detail: If the gateway is unavailable, restore its service or explicitly remove the profile configuration to choose the ordinary local source. There is no automatic fallback. Before downgrading to the independent fallback-only build, remove sekrets_profile because it rejects that configuration; no database recovery required.
